Thank you for reaching out and sharing your concern regarding the discrepancy between your actual working time and the time recorded by the system. We truly appreciate your commitment to maintaining high-quality work and consistency.

To clarify, the system automatically tracks both active and inactive time while you're on a task. If your cursor or keyboard remains idle for more than 9 seconds, the system will pause the active timer and begin counting that period as inactive time.

You can identify this by the color indicator:

When the clock is paused, the time will be highlighted in yellow.
When the time is being counted as active, it will appear in grey.

This may result in reduced logged time, even if you're still focused on the task but not actively interacting with the screen. To prevent this, it is strongly recommended, save your tasks and close the task page or log out whenever you are away from your PC, even briefly.
